Good to Know

Frequently asked questions

Are the cars private and air-conditioned?

Yes. Every journey is in a private, sanitised AC car with an experienced driver. You never share your vehicle with other travellers.

Which car should I choose?

Our sedans (Dzire / Etios) suit couples and small families of up to 4. For larger groups or extra luggage, ask us about our spacious family vehicles.

Can I customise my itinerary?

Absolutely. Pick one of our tours or tell us your interests and we will build a plan around you, with food stops, photo spots and hidden gems.

How do I book?

Fill in the booking form or message us on WhatsApp. We reply with a personalised plan and price, and you confirm once everything looks right.

Do you offer airport and railway pickups?

Yes. Add your pickup location in the booking form and your driver will meet you on arrival.

Terms & Conditions

Before you book

Two simple things to know so your journey runs smoothly.

  1. Pickup location

    Please specify your pickup location clearly and correctly when booking. If the pickup location given is incorrect, the fault lies entirely with the customer.

  2. Payment

    The booking amount is to be paid after your booking is confirmed. The full payment is to be made on completion of the tour.

  3. Accepted payment methods

    We accept payment by Mastercard, Visa, UPI and bank transfer. An extra fee applies to all card transactions.

  4. Accommodation

    We do not provide hotels yet. Accommodation is not included in our tours and should be arranged by the customer.

  5. Guide charges

    The car rental price does not include a guide. If you would like a guide, the guide charge is extra and is payable in addition to the car price. Guides are available in English, French, Spanish, Hindi and German. Please tell us your preferred language when booking.

  6. Cancellation during the tour

    Once the journey has begun, cancellation is not available. The complete payment for the booked tour remains payable.

  7. Cancellation after arrival at pickup

    If the booking is cancelled after our driver has reached the pickup point, the payment made will be non-refundable.
